description: Search Repolode's curated open-source projects by keyword, category or programming language. Returns name, one-line summary, stars, weekly star gain, license and links.

language.description: Programming language as GitHub names it, e.g. 'Python', 'TypeScript', 'Rust'.

limit.description: How many results, at most 25; default 10.

locale.description: Language of the summaries; default en.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'self-hosted notes' or 'mcp server for postgres'.

sort.description: Order: most stars (default), trending this week, recently added, recently updated.

name: search_repos
title: Search open-source projects
